title: One field makes the conscious mind serial

statements.text: The brain has one electromagnetic field, so two thoughts in it interfere like two stones thrown into one pond. The brain divides into a parallel nonconscious neuronal processor and a serial conscious field processor that does one thing at a time.

sources.quote: two thoughts emerging within a brain’s global EM field will always interfere with one another
a conscious EM field-based serial processor that can only do one thing at a time
